decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells and creatures to dominate the game. It includes a mix of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to outplay opponents. The key strategy is to establish board control through efficient removal and counter magic, while also using powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to pressure opponents. The inclusion of The One Ring as a win condition adds an extra layer of threat to the deck, allowing for a versatile and powerful approach to winning the game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on a mix of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By combining powerful threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief with disruptive tools like Thoughtseize and Terminate, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide additional ways to protect and recur key creatures, allowing for sustained aggression throughout the game. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger further adds disruption and versatility to the deck's game plan.

This deck focuses on controlling the board with a combination of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six, as well as removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Solitude to maintain control and pressure the opponent. With a mix of land fetch cards and powerful lands like Boseiju, Who Endures, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building towards a strong late game presence with cards like Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines and Nissa, Resurgent Animist.

The deck focuses on casting spells with Cascade mechanics to quickly overwhelm the opponent with creatures. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the player can continually cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Subtlety. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Mystical Dispute and Force of Negation to protect its strategy. Additionally, the deck includes a mix of burn spells and creature threats to apply pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and efficient in its game plan.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands to generate a significant amount of mana in order to play powerful threats and control the game. The deck runs cards like Expedition Map and Sylvan Scrying to find the Urza lands efficiently, while also including powerful control pieces like Karn, the Great Creator and Oblivion Stone to deal with threats. With access to cards like Wurmcoil Engine and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, the deck aims to establish a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on assembling the Heliod Life combo as quickly as possible, using cards like Collected Company and Ranger-Captain of Eos to search for key pieces. With Auriok Champion and Spike Feeder on the battlefield, players can create an infinite life gain loop that also generates an infinite number of +1/+1 counters on a creature, typically Walking Ballista. This allows for a quick win condition through overwhelming life total or damage. The deck also includes support cards like Conclave Mentor to enhance the effectiveness of the combo.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Living End combo to quickly and efficiently clear the board of creatures and then deploy a powerful board presence of your own. By cycling through your deck with cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will, you can set up the perfect Living End play. Cards like Shardless Agent and Curator of Mysteries help you dig deeper into your deck for key combo pieces, while cards like Grief and Force of Negation help disrupt your opponent's game plan. Once you resolve Living End, you can overwhelm your opponent with creatures like Waker of Waves and Oliphaunt to secure victory.

The deck focuses on using creatures with abilities to create a toolbox approach for combo plays. It utilizes cards like Wall of Roots and Strangleroot Geist for mana acceleration and resilience, while also including creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide for combo potential. The deck also features cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to tutor for specific creatures when needed. With a mix of creatures for different situations and combo potential, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its versatile playstyle.

The key concept of this deck revolves around ramping up mana quickly with cards like Search for Tomorrow and Sakura-Tribe Elder, while controlling the board with Lightning Bolt and Wrenn and Six. The win condition is to assemble The One Ring combo by getting Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and mountains onto the battlefield, along with Scapeshift to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Primeval Titan and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove for added versatility and consistency in executing the combo.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's hand and board while applying pressure with low-cost aggressive creatures. The deck utilizes discard spells like Thoughtseize and Grief to strip the opponent's hand while playing efficient removal like Terminate and Fatal Push to control the board. Aggressive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker provide constant pressure, supported by cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect and enhance them. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and disrupt their game plan to gain a quick victory.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay utilizing cheap creatures and spells to put pressure on the opponent. By using disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan, as well as powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent before they can establish control. The inclusion of cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice allows for additional evasion and resilience, making it difficult for the opponent to effectively deal with the threats presented by this Rakdos Aggro deck.

The key concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to use disruptive hand disruption spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, along with graveyard hate cards like Relic of Progenitus, to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Karn, the Great Creator and powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to generate card advantage and control the board. The deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Demolition Field, while also ramping into powerful late-game threats like The One Ring.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively disrupt and pressure the opponent's game plan using efficient creatures, hand disruption spells, and removal to control the board. The deck aims to apply early pressure with powerful threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, while disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and utilizing removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to clear the way for attacks. This Aggro Rakdos deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creature cards that work together to create powerful combinations and synergies. It utilizes cards like Wall of Roots, Strangleroot Geist, and Young Wolf to generate value and maintain board presence. With cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, it can tutor for specific creatures to fit the situation. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician allows for card advantage and creature removal. The deck also features cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to further enhance its creature toolbox strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to quickly pressure the opponent while disrupting their hand with cards like Thoughtseize. By combining powerful threats with disruption spells like Terminate and Fatal Push, the deck aims to consistently apply pressure to the opponent and control the battlefield. Additionally, the deck incorporates recursion effects like Feign Death and Undying Malice to make the most out of its creatures and spells, ensuring the opponent is constantly on the back foot.

The main concept of this Modern 1 vs 1 Combo - Hammer Time deck is to quickly assemble the combination of Puresteel Paladin, Sigarda's Aid, and Colossus Hammer to equip a creature, such as Inkmoth Nexus, with a powerful equipment and deal massive damage in a single turn. The deck includes cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift to search for the necessary pieces, as well as disruption spells like Spell Pierce to protect the combo. The deck also includes cards like Esper Sentinel and Giver of Runes for additional support and protection.
